# switch

<!-- Generated from native authoring; do not edit. -->

[中文](switch-style.zh.md)

`Styles.switch.*` — toggle switch elements for binary on/off states.

---

## Variants

### `switch.darkmode`

<a id="entry-switch-darkmode"></a>

Dark mode switch

[UI design software vs. coding - Bilibili] https://b23.tv/e7a99zR

Give a switch a day/night appearance.

Adds darkmode and hides its label slot; switch CSS draws alternate sky/thumb appearances for checked state.

This does not change the application theme. Bind the switch value to the theme controller separately and retain an accessible name.

Dark mode toggle switch variant. Hides the label slot and uses a moon/sun icon indicator appropriate for theme switching.

```javascript jaml-playground
export default [
    {
        type: 'switch',
        cap: 'Dark Mode',
        styles: ['switch.darkmode']
    }
];
```

### `switch.invert`

<a id="entry-switch-invert"></a>

Invert switch

Put a switch caption after its control.

Adds invert; the switch stylesheet changes caption order and margin.

It does not invert the boolean value.

Inverts the switch — the toggle track color is reversed so the "on" state appears visually as the default side. Use for agreement/terms checkboxes where the checked state should be the expected default.

```javascript jaml-playground
export default [
    {
        type: 'switch',
        cap: 'I agree to the Terms of Service',
        defaultValue: false,
        styles: ['switch.invert']
    }
];
```

## `switch.disc`

<a id="entry-switch-disc"></a>

Disc box

Show a single checkbox or radio switch as a large round disc.

Adds disc. A checked switch shows a filled disc with a check or radio dot cut out. An indeterminate checkbox shows a lighter disc with a bar cut out. An unchecked switch shows an empty ring. The disc is sized in em, so the switch's font size sets it.

## `switch.inline`

<a id="entry-switch-inline"></a>

Inline layout

Opt the selected target into its framework inline presentation.

Adds jam-inline to the path-selected target.

The selected component or target stylesheet must implement the inline class.

This is a class convention, not an unconditional inline display declaration.

## `switch.text.mono`

<a id="entry-switch-text-mono"></a>

Monospace

Use the theme monospace font family on the path-selected target.

Nested text.mono presets select sys.typography.fontFamily.mono.

The root text.mono extension instead uses the generic monospace family.

## `switch.color.accent`

<a id="entry-switch-color-accent"></a>

Strong color

Choose strong foreground emphasis or an accent foreground according to the path.

color.strong uses the strong foreground token; nested color.accent uses the primary foreground token and adds the colored class.

These are different roles. The root color.accent path has a separate color-profile behavior and is not part of this shared preset group.

## `switch.background.tint`

<a id="entry-switch-background-tint"></a>

Tint

Sets background-color from sys.color.tint.default.

Pair the fill with a foreground role appropriate to that surface. Choose the path for the intended host, slotted content, or slot wrapper; a slot wrapper and the content assigned to it are different targets.

## `switch.text.size.3xl`

<a id="entry-switch-text-size-3xl"></a>

Triple extra large

Apply the theme 3xl typography size to the selected content.

Sets font-size from sys.typography.fontSize.3xl.

Combine with the appropriate font, line height, and wrapping behavior; changing font size changes text metrics and can affect wrapping and layout.
